_about: Walls whose edges were checked by hand, the test of wall_edges_rule.py. A line the wall goes on across (into itself, its copy or its mirror image) is never an edge: on the 3-sphere the wall carries on there. So T2 has no D1 (its copy across), X26 no D2 or D3, X10 no C3, X38 no C2a, F1 no D3. T2: E2, T1, X1, X4. X17: X2, X4 (it ends on X4 along its b1=b3 patch). X26: X2. X38: B1, E1. X10: D1, X3, X8, X9. X39: X8, X29, X23.
